title: Walungan Anu Ngungkabkeun Hate
intro: Bayangkeun hiji pasukan nu keur maju, haus jeung diuji, di mana hiji komando di sisi walungan bakal misahkeun tekad jeung kahayang. Pamingpin nu dipilih nungtun barisan nuju musuh nu perkasa, mawa kapercayaan ka Allah wungkul.
clues: Abdi diangkat ku Allah janten pamimpin Bani Israil saatos aranjeunna nyuhunkeun hiji jalmi pikeun perang di jalan-Na.
Kuring dipasihan élmu pangaweruh anu loba jeung jangkung salaku tanda kapilih, sanajan rahayat kuring mempertanyakan otoritas kuring.
Kuring angkat jeung pasukan terus nyarita ka aranjeunna yen Allah bakal nguji aranjeunna ku walungan.
Kuring geus ngingetkeun saha waé anu nginumna kalawan bébas, moal kaasup golongan kuring, kajaba jalma anu nyeuseup sakeupeul.
Kuring meuntas jeung sababaraha urang anu tetep pageuh, nyanghareupan pasukan anu jauh leuwih loba jumlahna.
Kuring mingpin jalma-jalma anu nyarios sabaraha sering pasukan leutik ngéléhkeun pasukan ageung kalayan idin Allah, sateuacan Jalut éléh.

trial.label: Uji Coba/Acara
options: Nguji tentara ku walungan sateuacan perang
trial.answer: Nguji tentara ku walungan sateuacan perang

outcome.label: Hasil
options: Ngaleueut ku bumi ku harta karun
Meunang kalawan idin Allah sareng Jalut tiwas ku Dawud
Tilelep di laut jeung nu boga imah
outcome.answer: Meunang kalawan idin Allah sareng Jalut tiwas ku Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
